scientific_integrity: A direct state-matrix proof covers all prime powers. The code is a finite corroborating check, not a proof substitute. Previously known Narayana valuation results and tabulated modular periods are credited.
scientific_limitations: No exact multiplicities for residues congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 3 beyond the proved lower bounds; no classification at other primes. Older work may implicitly cover some branch congruences.
title: Five \(3\)-adic isometries and singleton residue fibres for Narayana numbers
